result.brief: 提出首个时间步感知的生成式视频压缩框架，用轻量预测器从压缩潜变量自适应选择去噪起始步，并通过时序适配器注入压缩感知条件，提升重建保真度与真实感。
result.reason: Uses pretrained video diffusion with compression-aware latent conditioning and adaptive denoising entry; contributes to generative latent-space video reconstruction, relevant to video generation and latent representation.
